posts.zh:
dsh-win-gitbash 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。面向 Windows 的 Git Bash 工具：通过 Git for Windows 自带的 bash 执行命令，支持超时、沙箱、输出截断与后台任务，替代卡顿的 pwsh 工具与仅限 WSL 的 bash 工具。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c4f5e8b660cdcd4ec05b.html
posts.en:
dsh-win-gitbash is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Git Bash shell tool for Windows: runs commands through the bash bundled with Git for Windows, with timeout, sandbox, output truncation, and background jobs, replacing the slow pwsh tool and the WSL-only bash tool.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c4f5e8b660cdcd4ec05b.html
